efisiensi_modal.title: Leverage System
efisiensi_modal.content: Through the Margin Trading facility with a leverage system, investors can conduct transactions with greater value compared to the provided capital. Customers do not need to deposit 100% funds like in stock trading (full margin), so relatively small capital can already be used to access broader transaction opportunities.

fleksibilitas_transaksi.title: Transaction Flexibility
fleksibilitas_transaksi.content: Derivative products offer flexibility through a two-way transaction mechanism, so customers can take advantage of opportunities when prices move up or down. With this feature, profit opportunities remain open as long as the market shows clear trend movements.

pergerakan_harga.title: Dynamic Price Movements
pergerakan_harga.content: Derivative instruments have characteristics of fluctuating price movements, providing broader transaction opportunities for customers. Daily movements in various products—from stock indices that can move 100–500 points, Loco London gold by 10–20 troy ounces, to forex moving 100–150 pips—open up significant profit potential. With contract values such as US$ 5 per point for indices, 100,000 per currency in forex, and 100 troy ounces for Loco London gold, customers can maximize market opportunities with relatively small transaction costs.

likuiditas_tinggi.title: High Liquidity
likuiditas_tinggi.content: Derivative products have very high liquidity levels, so customers can conduct buy or sell transactions anytime during market hours. Trading activities are also supported by an online trading system that allows for fast, transparent, and easy access execution.

tanpa_batasan_waktu.title: No Time Limit for Open Positions
tanpa_batasan_waktu.content: Customers have full freedom to determine the duration of maintaining transaction positions without any penalties or administrative fees when withdrawing funds or closing accounts. This flexibility provides space for customers to adjust strategies according to market conditions.
